content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, Filipino digital creators can leap over the hurdles of traditional payment systems by [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-complete-14|COREMERCH guide to setting]] up a blockchain-based payment infrastructure. Utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can deploy a fully functional online store in just 48 hours. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order management, and NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions. You will have your digital products ready for sale, with low fees and no dependency on mainstream platforms.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack for creators includes essential components that ensure you can start selling immediately. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you have everything configured for optimum performance. You will benefit from SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings to ensure your emails reach buyers, and end-to-end testing guarantees everything functions correctly before you hand off your store. This ensures that your payment process is reliable and secure, allowing you to focus on your creations rather than technical hurdles.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Avoid getting bogged down in steps that don't impact your ability to start selling quickly. For instance, advanced marketing strategies or extensive product line expansions can come later. Focus on setting up your store, integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and ensuring your products are ready for immediate download. This streamlined approach allows you to launch your offerings without unnecessary delays, ensuring you can start making sales as soon as possible.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographic restrictions for creators.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To initiate your first transaction, ensure that your NOWPayments account is properly configured and linked to your store. A simple setup lets you accept various cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a minimal fee. Promote your store through social media channels and relevant forums to attract customers. Once the first transaction occurs, you'll gain confidence in your system, paving the way for future sales.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

Within the next 24 hours, complete the deployment of your Edge Commerce Stack and finalize product listings. Ensure your payment system is active and test transactions to verify that everything is functioning correctly. After testing, leverage social media to announce your launch. Engage with your audience and provide compelling reasons for them to purchase your digital products. This proactive approach will maximize your reach and potential sales quickly.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Swift crypto transactions mean no more waiting for payment confirmations.

For creators exploring payment solutions, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive way to set up a store with integrated payment methods. Related searches highlight the need for viable options in regions lacking traditional payment support. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for tools to help establish your digital storefront.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
